item_name: Rothco Thin Blue Line Canvas Shoulder Duffle Bag
item_short_desc: Rothco's Thin Blue Line Canvas Shoulder Duffle Bag is more than just a bag—it's a statement of support for law enforcement officials. Crafted from durable heavyweight cotton canvas, this 19 inch x 9 inch duffle bag is designed to withstand the rigors of travel, gym sessions, or everyday use. The parotic bag features a zippered end pocket for quick access to essential items, making it incredibly practical for those on the go. The adjustable and detachable shoulder strap offers comfort and versatility, allowing you to carry it your way.
description: Rothco's Thin Blue Line Canvas Shoulder Duffle Bag is more than just a bag—it's a statement of support for law enforcement officials. Crafted from durable heavyweight cotton canvas, this 19 inch x 9 inch duffle bag is designed to withstand the rigors of travel, gym sessions, or everyday use. The parotic bag features a zippered end pocket for quick access to essential items, making it incredibly practical for those on the go. The adjustable and detachable shoulder strap offers comfort and versatility, allowing you to carry it your way. With each purchase, a portion of the proceeds goes directly to benefit the families of fallen first responders, making this bag not only a functional accessory but also a meaningful contribution to a worthy cause. The iconic Thin Blue Line design symbolizes respect and support for law enforcement, ensuring that you carry your gear with pride.
